result.summary: Added godot/scripts/core/save_world_runtime_install.gd, a stateless SAVE-W1-R02 helper whose single public install() validates nulls, the manager-owned load barrier, the WorldRuntime record, an int32 world seed, header/record tick equality, the mandatory rng_seeded flag, the section 10 stream shape and seed-dependent HUNTING tombstone, and sim_clock's pure restore_refusal before touching anything; it then captures the prior RNG (seeded flag, seed, nine state/count pairs), installs RNG first through seed_world plus SaveSectionRng.apply, and installs the ten clock scalars last through GameManager.restore_clock_runtime. Any install failure rolls the RNG back to its pre-call state (clear for a previously unseeded store, otherwise prior seed plus the captured pairs) and returns the original refusal; a rollback that itself refuses returns SAVE_WORLD_ROLLBACK_FAILED naming the failing operation and leaves the barrier held, with no manager-wide unrecoverable latch claimed. It never acquires or releases the barrier, never publishes, never calls rollback_load, start_game, set_speed, set_pause, advance or any queue operation, and adds no production fault flags. Added godot/test/test_save_world_runtime_install.gd exercising real GameManager, RNG and both codecs through genuine encode/decode round trips: draw-parity against an uninterrupted source store, unequal per-stream draw counts, a different prior seed, a previously unseeded target, debt 1/999999/1000000/2500001, speeds 1/2/4, composite masks, six distinct counters, terminal representable tick, tombstone canonicality, silence of all four manager signals, unchanged queue state, barrier-held/unpublished postconditions, input records left unaliased, and the full refusal matrix with byte-identical clock/RNG evidence. Fault injection is confined to test subclasses overriding the public restore_stream, seed_world and restore_clock_runtime APIs, covering the seeded rollback path, the unseeded rollback path and an explicit unrecoverable rollback-write failure. Acknowledged decisions: SAVE-W1-R02 and RESTORE-R01. No tools were run and no test execution or verification is claimed.
